exposure: Trans nasal Sphenopalatine Ganglion Block (SPGB) with 4% Lignocaine
outcome: Time taken to obtain clinical effects
cohort: 60 patients aged 18-40 years, ASA I & II, undergoing elective or emergency lower segment caesarean section under spinal anaesthesia.
finding: Trans nasal Sphenopalatine Ganglion Block (SPGB) resulted in significantly lower VAS scores and provided quicker and better relief for Post-Dural Puncture Headache (PDPH) compared to Oral NSAIDs.
